loginTitle: Log in to your Simple Bank account

authInfoDescription: Simple Bank uses this device instead of a password to prove it's you.

authInfoPoint2Body: Logging in from another device or browser is blocked automatically.
authInfoPoint3Body: No password to create, forget, or reset — just your email and this device.
